marks.gloss_en: it was taught: a woman would sort wheat by the light of the Beit HaShoeva
some of them would say: happy is our youth, which did not shame our old age
אי הכי, חמש עשרה מעלות -- יורדות מיבעי ליה! if the songs brought the deep down, they should be called 'descents', not 'ascents'

[Rav Chisda: against what did David say the fifteen ascents?] the sage: thus said R' Yochanan: when David dug the shitin, the deep rose and sought to flood the world; David said the fifteen ascents and brought it down
since you have reminded me of the matter, thus it was stated: when David dug the shitin, the deep rose and sought to flood the world
שנאמר: בכל המקום אשר אזכיר את שמי אבוא אליך וברכתיך -- Hillel's verse for 'if you come to my house I will come to yours' (kind svara is the residual kind; no ta_shema marker)
Hillel: if I am here, all is here; and if I am not here, who is here

והא גרמא ליה? והאמר רבי אלעזר... ואיטלע, ומנו לוי -- was it the kidda that caused it? R' Elazar assigns Levi's dislocation to his impertinent speech (kind svara under protest: the והאמר memra-contradiction has no kind, §12)
הא והא גרמא ליה -- both caused it (= p_ha_veha_garma)
Levi demonstrated kidda before Rebbi and was dislocated [lamed] -- the kidda is what caused it
איני? והאמר רבי יוחנן: שבועה שלא אישן שלשה ימים -- מלקין אותו וישן לאלתר -- one cannot go three days without sleep (kind svara under protest, §12)
אלא הכי קאמר: לא טעמנו טעם שינה, דהוו מנמנמי אכתפא דהדדי (= p_lo_taamnu_taam_shena)
R' Yochanan: '[I take] an oath that I will not sleep three days' -- he is flogged and sleeps at once
he too saw a skull floating on the water and said to it: because you drowned, they drowned you, and those who drowned you will be drowned
those two Cushites who stood before Solomon, Elichoref and Achiya sons of Shisha, were Solomon's scribes
[Solomon:] why are you glad? He said to him: to the place where they asked them of me, there you sent them
rejoicing, he would take eight torches of light, throw one and take one, and they did not touch one another
Levi would juggle before Rebbi with eight knives
R' Yehoshua ben Chananya: when we rejoiced at the Simchat Beit HaShoeva we saw no sleep in our eyes
